title: LLM Prompting and Messaging
summary: This module provides core components for constructing and managing prompts for Large Language Models (LLMs), including various prompt templates (chat, few-shot, structured) and utilities for handling and translating message content across different LLM providers.

nodes.label: Represent Concrete Chat Prompt Value
nodes.title: Concrete Chat Prompt Value
nodes.description: A concrete representation of a chat prompt's value, explicitly listing the message types it contains. Used for defining external schemas and ensuring type safety in prompt construction.

nodes.label: Create AI Message Prompt
nodes.title: AI Message Prompt Template
nodes.description: A specialized prompt template for generating AI messages, inheriting from the base message prompt template. It defines the structure and content for AI-generated responses.

nodes.label: Create System Message Prompt
nodes.title: System Message Prompt Template
nodes.description: A specialized prompt template for generating system messages, which provide context or instructions to the AI model without being directly visible to the end-user.

nodes.label: Create Generic Chat Message Prompt
nodes.title: Chat Message Prompt Template
nodes.description: A versatile prompt template for creating chat messages with a specified role (e.g., human, AI, system). It formats input variables into a BaseMessage object.

nodes.label: Generate Few-Shot Chat Messages
nodes.title: Few-Shot Chat Message Prompt Template
nodes.description: A chat prompt template that incorporates few-shot examples to guide the language model's behavior. It can use fixed examples or dynamically select them based on input.

nodes.label: Generate Few-Shot String Prompt
nodes.title: Few-Shot Prompt with Templates
nodes.description: A string-based prompt template that includes few-shot examples, allowing for dynamic example selection and flexible formatting using prefix, suffix, and example prompts.

nodes.label: Load Few-Shot Prompt from Config
nodes.title: Load Few-Shot Prompt
nodes.description: A utility function responsible for loading and configuring a FewShotPromptTemplate from a dictionary-based configuration, handling example prompts and selectors.

nodes.label: Load Generic Prompt from Config
nodes.title: Load Generic Prompt
nodes.description: A utility function to load a PromptTemplate from a configuration dictionary, supporting various template formats and ensuring proper setup of the prompt.

nodes.label: Base for Message Prompts
nodes.title: Base Message Prompt Template
nodes.description: An abstract base class for all message prompt templates, defining the interface for formatting messages from keyword arguments into a list of BaseMessage objects.

nodes.label: Format Template with Jinja2
nodes.title: Jinja2 Template Formatter
nodes.description: A function that formats a given template string using the Jinja2 templating engine. It uses a sandboxed environment for security, rendering variables into the template.

nodes.label: Format Template with Mustache
nodes.title: Mustache Template Formatter
nodes.description: A function that formats a given template string using the Mustache templating engine. It substitutes variables in the template with provided keyword arguments.

nodes.label: Base for String Prompts
nodes.title: String Prompt Template
nodes.description: An abstract base class for prompt templates that produce a string output. It provides methods for formatting the prompt and converting it into a PromptValue.

nodes.label: Define Prompt with Output Schema
nodes.title: Structured Prompt Template
nodes.description: A specialized chat prompt template designed to enforce a structured output format from the language model, typically by piping to a model with structured output capabilities.

nodes.label: Register Provider Translators
nodes.title: Register Message Block Translators
nodes.description: A function that registers all built-in message block translators for various LLM providers within the langchain-core, enabling consistent message content handling.

nodes.label: Extract Anthropic Content Blocks
nodes.title: Anthropic Content Block Iterator
nodes.description: Iterates through and extracts content blocks from Anthropic-specific message formats, converting them into a standardized internal representation for processing.

nodes.label: Translate Bedrock Message
nodes.title: Translate Bedrock Message Content
nodes.description: Translates the content of an AIMessage from Bedrock-specific formats into a list of standardized internal content blocks, primarily for Anthropic models on Bedrock.

nodes.label: Translate Bedrock Message Chunk
nodes.title: Translate Bedrock Message Chunk
nodes.description: Translates the content of an AIMessageChunk from Bedrock-specific formats into a list of standardized internal content blocks, supporting streaming responses.

nodes.label: Extract Bedrock Converse Blocks
nodes.title: Bedrock Converse Block Iterator
nodes.description: Iterates through and extracts content blocks from Bedrock Converse API message formats, converting them into a standardized internal representation for processing.

nodes.label: Translate Google GenAI Message
nodes.title: Translate Google GenAI Content
nodes.description: Translates the content of an AIMessage from Google Generative AI-specific formats into a list of standardized internal content blocks for consistent handling.

nodes.label: Translate Google GenAI Chunk
nodes.title: Translate Google GenAI Chunk
nodes.description: Translates the content of an AIMessageChunk from Google Generative AI-specific formats into a list of standardized internal content blocks, supporting streaming responses.

nodes.label: Translate Groq Message
nodes.title: Translate Groq Message Content
nodes.description: Translates the content of an AIMessage from Groq-specific formats into a list of standardized internal content blocks for consistent handling within LangChain.

nodes.label: Translate Groq Message Chunk
nodes.title: Translate Groq Message Chunk
nodes.description: Translates the content of an AIMessageChunk from Groq-specific formats into a list of standardized internal content blocks, supporting streaming responses.

nodes.label: Translate OpenAI Message
nodes.title: Translate OpenAI Message Content
nodes.description: Translates the content of an AIMessage from OpenAI-specific formats (chat completions or responses) into a list of standardized internal content blocks.

nodes.label: Translate OpenAI Message Chunk
nodes.title: Translate OpenAI Message Chunk
nodes.description: Translates the content of an AIMessageChunk from OpenAI-specific formats (chat completions or responses) into a list of standardized internal content blocks, supporting streaming.

nodes.label: Extract OpenAI Content Blocks
nodes.title: OpenAI Content Block Iterator
nodes.description: Iterates through and extracts content blocks from OpenAI-specific message formats, converting them into a standardized internal representation for processing.

nodes.label: Convert OpenAI Chat Input
nodes.title: Convert OpenAI Chat Input Blocks
nodes.description: Converts OpenAI Chat Completions format blocks into the internal v1 content block format, handling various data types like images, audio, and files.

nodes.label: Create Text Block
nodes.title: Create Text Content Block
nodes.description: A factory function to create a standardized TextContentBlock, encapsulating text content, optional annotations, and an identifier for message construction.

nodes.label: Create Image Block
nodes.title: Create Image Content Block
nodes.description: A factory function to create a standardized ImageContentBlock, supporting image data via URL, base64 encoding, or file ID, along with an optional MIME type.

nodes.label: Create Video Block
nodes.title: Create Video Content Block
nodes.description: A factory function to create a standardized VideoContentBlock, supporting video data via URL, base64 encoding, or file ID, and requiring a MIME type for base64.

nodes.label: Create Audio Block
nodes.title: Create Audio Content Block
nodes.description: A factory function to create a standardized AudioContentBlock, supporting audio data via URL, base64 encoding, or file ID, and requiring a MIME type for base64.

nodes.label: Create File Block
nodes.title: Create File Content Block
nodes.description: A factory function to create a standardized FileContentBlock, supporting generic file data via URL, base64 encoding, or file ID, and requiring a MIME type for base64.

nodes.label: Create Plaintext Block
nodes.title: Create Plaintext Content Block
nodes.description: A factory function to create a standardized PlainTextContentBlock, encapsulating plain text content, optionally from a URL, base64, or file ID, with title and context.

nodes.label: Create Reasoning Block
nodes.title: Create Reasoning Content Block
nodes.description: A factory function to create a standardized ReasoningContentBlock, used to represent the thought process or internal reasoning of an AI model.

nodes.label: Create Non-Standard Block
nodes.title: Create Non-Standard Content Block
nodes.description: A factory function to create a NonStandardContentBlock, used to wrap provider-specific content data that does not fit into predefined standardized content block types.

nodes.label: Approximate Token Count
nodes.title: Approximate Token Counter
nodes.description: A utility function that provides an approximate count of tokens for a sequence of BaseMessage objects, useful for managing context window limits in LLMs.

nodes.label: Wrap Function as Runnable
nodes.title: Function Wrapper for Runnable
nodes.description: A utility function that transforms a regular Python function into a LangChain Runnable, allowing it to be integrated into complex chains and workflows. It supports both direct invocation and deferred runnable creation.

nodes.label: Merge Consecutive Messages
nodes.title: Merge Message Runs
nodes.description: Merges consecutive messages of the same type into a single message, concatenating string content or combining content blocks. Useful for optimizing message history.

nodes.label: Filter Messages by Criteria
nodes.title: Filter Messages
nodes.description: Filters a sequence of messages based on various criteria such as message name, type, ID, or tool call IDs, allowing for precise control over message selection.

nodes.label: Truncate Messages by Token Count
nodes.title: Truncate Messages by Token Count
nodes.description: Truncates a list of messages to fit within a specified maximum token limit, prioritizing the most recent messages while optionally preserving system messages.

nodes.label: Base Prompt Template
nodes.title: Base Prompt Template
nodes.description: The foundational abstract class for all prompt templates, defining the basic interface for formatting inputs into a prompt string or value.

nodes.label: Base Message Type
nodes.title: Base Message
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all message types in LangChain, providing a common interface for different roles like human, AI, and system messages.

nodes.label: AI Message Type
nodes.title: AI Message
nodes.description: Represents a message generated by an AI model, containing the AI's response content, which can be text, structured data, or a combination of content blocks.

nodes.label: AI Message Chunk Type
nodes.title: AI Message Chunk
nodes.description: Represents a partial or streaming chunk of an AI message, used for incremental updates during real-time generation from language models.

nodes.label: Chat Prompt Template
nodes.title: Chat Prompt Template
nodes.description: A prompt template specifically designed for chat-based interactions, allowing the construction of prompts from a sequence of message-like representations.

nodes.label: Chat Prompt Value
nodes.title: Chat Prompt Value
nodes.description: A value object representing a chat prompt, typically containing a sequence of messages that can be passed to a chat model.

nodes.label: Base Language Model
nodes.title: Base Language Model
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all language models, defining the fundamental interface for interacting with LLMs, including methods for generation and structured output.

nodes.label: Runnable Interface
nodes.title: Runnable
nodes.description: The core interface for all LangChain components that can be invoked, streamed, or batched, enabling flexible composition of complex applications.

nodes.label: Serializable Runnable
nodes.title: RunnableSerializable
nodes.description: An extension of the Runnable interface that adds serialization capabilities, allowing components to be saved and loaded for persistence and sharing.

nodes.label: Prompt Value
nodes.title: Prompt Value
nodes.description: A generic value object representing a formatted prompt, which can be converted into different formats suitable for various language models.

nodes.label: Generic Content Block
nodes.title: Content Block
nodes.description: A fundamental data structure representing a single piece of content within a message, such as text, images, or tool calls, allowing for multimodal messages.

nodes.label: Text Content Block Type
nodes.title: Text Content Block
nodes.description: A specific type of ContentBlock dedicated to holding textual information, often including annotations or metadata related to the text.

nodes.label: Image Content Block Type
nodes.title: Image Content Block
nodes.description: A specific type of ContentBlock designed to represent image data, which can be provided as a URL, base64 encoded string, or a file ID.

nodes.label: Video Content Block Type
nodes.title: Video Content Block
nodes.description: A specific type of ContentBlock for video data, supporting various sources like URLs, base64 encoded strings, or file IDs, along with its MIME type.

nodes.label: Audio Content Block Type
nodes.title: Audio Content Block
nodes.description: A specific type of ContentBlock for audio data, allowing specification via URL, base64 encoded string, or file ID, and its corresponding MIME type.

nodes.label: File Content Block Type
nodes.title: File Content Block
nodes.description: A generic ContentBlock type for arbitrary file data, which can be referenced by URL, base64 encoded content, or a file ID, and includes its MIME type.

nodes.label: Plain Text Content Block Type
nodes.title: Plain Text Content Block
nodes.description: A specialized ContentBlock for plain text, offering options to specify content directly, or via URL, base64, or file ID, with additional title and context fields.

nodes.label: Reasoning Content Block Type
nodes.title: Reasoning Content Block
nodes.description: A ContentBlock type specifically for representing the internal reasoning or thought process of an AI model, often used in agentic workflows.

nodes.label: Non-Standard Content Block Type
nodes.title: Non-Standard Content Block
nodes.description: A flexible ContentBlock type used to encapsulate provider-specific or custom content data that does not fit into any of the predefined standard content block types.

groups.label: Prompt Templates
groups.title: Prompt Template Definitions
groups.description: Components for defining and structuring various types of prompts, including chat, few-shot, and structured prompts, serving as the foundation for LLM interaction.

groups.label: Prompt Utilities
groups.title: Prompt Configuration and Formatting
groups.description: Utility functions for loading prompt configurations from various sources and formatting template strings using different templating engines like Jinja2 and Mustache.

groups.label: Message Content Translation
groups.title: LLM Provider Message Translation
groups.description: Components responsible for translating and extracting message content and chunks from various LLM provider-specific formats (e.g., Anthropic, Bedrock, Google GenAI, Groq, OpenAI) into a standardized internal representation.

groups.label: Message Content Creation
groups.title: Standardized Content Block Creation
groups.description: Factory functions for creating various types of standardized content blocks (text, image, video, audio, file, plaintext, reasoning, non-standard) that compose multimodal messages.

groups.label: Message Processing Utilities
groups.title: Message Manipulation and Analysis
groups.description: General utility functions for processing and manipulating message sequences, including token counting, merging consecutive messages, filtering messages, and truncating messages based on token limits.
